t: When something rises in you out of nowhere
a: وَإِمَّا يَنزَغَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنِ نَزْغٌ فَٱسْتَعِذْ بِٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
p: Wa immā yanzaghannaka mina-sh-shayṭāni nazghun fa-staʿidh billāh, innahu Samīʿun ʿAlīm.
m: And if an evil suggestion comes to you from Satan, then seek refuge in Allāh. Indeed, He is Hearing and Knowing.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
